raw_site_text: 128 municipalities ... located in one of the 17 states that held municipal elections in 2018 (footnote 11 lists the states)
justification: Footnote 11 lists the 17 eligible states; the 128 sample municipalities lie in those states.
note: Footnote lists states of eligibility; sample municipalities shown only in Online Appendix Fig B.1, so some listed states may have no sample municipality. 'Estado de Mexico' mapped to 'Mexico'.
